title: Binance Options Will Launch Additional BTCUSDT & ETHUSDT Weekly Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch additional BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Weekly Options on  2023-12-18  at  08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Weekly Options are European-style options contracts. Binance Options will launch additional BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Weekly Options on  2023-12-18  at  08:00 (UTC) . Please note that this is a  one-off  listing. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2023-12-18 Note: This announcement was last updated on 2024-01-09 to clarify that the additional BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Weekly Options listed on 2023-12-18 at 08:00 (UTC) is a one-off listing.
